entity_types.description: An independently identifiable stable organization or institution.
An independently identifiable product offered or provided to users or a market.
An executable, deployable or usable software system, program, library, framework or tool.
A technically meaningful technology, architecture, technical system, capability or technology family.
A method, algorithm, procedure, workflow or way of achieving a goal.
An abstract object that can be independently defined, discussed or used as a durable knowledge topic.
A relatively coherent explanatory theory or theoretical framework.
An independently identifiable organized collection of data.
An independently identifiable model used for training, inference, evaluation or deployment.
A formally standardized or normative specification.
A defined protocol for communication, interaction, coordination or interoperability.
A separately identifiable resource not reasonably classified as another registered Entity Type.
An independently identifiable geographic, spatial or site/location entity.
